worked: Single, age 45. Taxable income 3,090 is Example A of the Tax Calculation Worksheet, which shows 37.60 from the chart's rounded 26 and prints 38. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 18,840.00 = 18,840.00. Federal taxable income = 18,840.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 3,090.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 18,840.00. Line 2 additions 0.00. Line 3 total income 18,840.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 18,840.00 - 0.00 = 18,840.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 0.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 18,840.00 - 0.00 - 15,750.00 = 3,090.00. Line 29 taxable income 3,090.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 464.00 = 11.6; total 37.86 = 37.86. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 38; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 18,840.00 - Line 8 0.00 = 18,840.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 18,840.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
